name: kosis
description: Read KOSIS (Statistics Korea) national statistics from the command line, powered by the pykosis CLI

interface.longDescription: Search the KOSIS statistical-table catalog to find an organization and table code, fetch that table's observations as a time series, or read its metadata and survey documentation from the KOSIS Open API via the pykosis CLI. Needs a free KOSIS API key in KOSIS_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Find the KOSIS table code for the life table
Get a KOSIS statistical table as a time series
Show the metadata for a KOSIS table
